title: Sara Duterte not expecting 'fair trial' from ICC on father's case

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Friday said she is not expecting a “fair trial” for her father before the International Criminal Court (ICC), which is set to begin hearing the alleged crimes against humanity charges against former President Rodrigo Duterte in connection with his administration’s drug war. According to an ICC Trial Chamber III order dated November 26, the trial of the elder Duterte will open on November 30 with the presentation of the prosecution’s evidence and continue until the court’s judicial recess on December 18.
